factors.mechanism: Admission, heap participation and native lifetime are conflated; unknown result can cause unsafe reuse or unnecessarily broad GC veto
factors.sourceCondition: Accepted callback/result and final native user have explicit custodian and disposition; withdrawal proves frozen/no-write root boundary separately from handle closure
factors.nativeCondition: Inject known/unknown create/join and late callback outcomes; distinguish healthy other VM from progress inside affected VM; no heap access after certified withdrawal
factors.workMetric: GC veto/wait time; accepted, retained and disposed outcomes; progress under fault
factors.memoryMetric: Retained handles, roots and physical arenas per unresolved outcome; bound issuance on exhaustion
factors.boundary: Alias certificates cannot stop an unknown writer; published native callers need stronger evidence than empty startup actors
factors.argument_evidenceClass: source/lifecycle argument; no reconstruction of every crash
factors.argument_badHistory: Accepted callback or error survives its receiver; unknown join is used as either safe reuse or a VM-wide GC veto
factors.argument_rule: Outcome and native-user custody outlive execution admission; detach heap participation only with an immutable no-RUN empty-domain certificate; native reuse still requires known closure
factors.argument_premise: Complete legal senders, callback tails and OS-result inventory; a recoverable failure has an independent progress agent
factors.argument_refutation: A published actor still writes the heap, or a retained handler has no disposition; empty-startup isolation does not cover either

factors.mechanism: Carrier processor still selects participant roots/completion; idle counts cannot represent private frontier, Tail and future descendants
factors.sourceCondition: Root origin, participant epoch and claimed work are separate; every producer/private cursor/publication descendant accounted for; completion is task-scoped
factors.nativeCondition: Different worker/origin counts and worker handoff; late work and withdrawal never lose a root or complete a live phase
factors.workMetric: Queued/private/in-flight/descendant work, steals, idle waits and useful scans per worker
factors.memoryMetric: Task/cursor metadata and transfer-pending work retention at peak
factors.boundary: Role structs alone do not remove synchronous binding; complete producer inventory, source root freeze and fairness remain required
factors.argument_evidenceClass: current separated storage and conditional work-closure design
factors.argument_badHistory: A participant leaves while private frontier, Tail, weak-phase or release work can still create descendants
factors.argument_rule: ExecutionContext, GCParticipant and CollectorWorkContext have separate lifetimes; completion requires closed producers plus zero private, queued, running and descendant debt
factors.argument_premise: Every producer and last use mapped; publication orders payload visibility before consumer authority; scheduler fairness is separate
factors.argument_refutation: finish reopens work after close, or an exiting worker has the only unrecorded cursor; an empty queue is insufficient

factors.mechanism: Duplicate scan delivery can become duplicate field writers; forwarding/readiness/Tail are confused, and per-copy reserve is mistaken for a whole-round physical plan
factors.sourceCondition: One initializer and ordinary repair owner per destination; explicit Tail/link duties; injective contiguous intervals and resume reserve before flip; independent domains avoid global copy serialization
factors.nativeCondition: Repeat delivery and CAS loss under pair/frame sharing; no duplicate repair; reserve failure preserves source; same-profile whole-round peak fits actual intervals
factors.workMetric: Deliveries versus granted writers, copied/restored words, refunds and frame-domain contention
factors.memoryMetric: Scan metadata, reserved/published intervals, private Tail debt and whole-round physical high-water
factors.boundary: Recorded duplicate ordinary scan is a real conflict, not an explanation of every historical crash; current global frame gate and pre-flip planner remain open costs
factors.argument_evidenceClass: native duplicate ordinary-scan request witnessed; universal producer/crash explanation open
factors.argument_badHistory: Two delivered traversal requests repair the same destination fields, while forwarding visibility is mistaken for completed payload and Tail ownership
factors.argument_rule: Transport delivery is distinct from object write authority; one canonical initializer, one ordinary scanner and separately owned Tail/frame-link work; reserve a real contiguous interval before forwarding
factors.argument_premise: All pair/frame/weak adapters obey the same claim and publication protocol; closed source bound, maximum request and injective physical layout precede parity flip
factors.argument_refutation: Any bypass performs field repair without the claim; per-copy refunds are used as a whole-round capacity proof; raw-ready frame exposes an unfinished semantic link

factors.mechanism: Incoming values or resize payload can survive only in stale C locals; callback/marker allocation can precede real root registration
factors.sourceCondition: Root before collecting conversion/marker, frozen borrow view, post-GC reload, native origin and every exceptional exit covered; destination registration precedes source ACK
factors.nativeCondition: Both run origins, generated SFUN/CFUN, nested callbacks and nonzero processor roots under GC; late/unknown exits retain custody
factors.workMetric: Root register/reload, park/reentry, scan visits and native participation waits
factors.memoryMetric: Fixed control storage separately from retained Scheme graph/native payload; frozen borrowers at peak
factors.boundary: A complete alias adapter cannot supply absent raw native access bounds or initialize marker roots retroactively
factors.argument_evidenceClass: actual request transport replaced; full raw FFI writer coverage open
factors.argument_badHistory: Movable thunk lives only in a copied sync operation across another request's GC; nested entry allocates before incoming root registration
factors.argument_rule: Register VM-owned root before publishing stable origin/serial; consumers reload after GC; ACK only after consumption and transport drain; generated native activation plans protect pre-marker inputs
factors.argument_premise: Every GC-capable conversion, nested callback, exceptional exit and raw borrower is covered or explicitly excluded; no stale C local is treated as a root
factors.argument_refutation: A new conversion allocates before the root plan or an exceptional ACK removes a still-readable source; fixed slot count does not bound retained graph bytes

factors.mechanism: Foreign destructor can require an owner callback while that owner waits for collector completion, producing a wait cycle
factors.sourceCondition: Effects, affinity, rooted payload and pre-GC budget declared; eligible release work accepted and drained with descendants after required owner execution is permitted
factors.nativeCondition: Real release producers, reentrant callbacks, cancellation and shutdown partial failures; neither GC completion nor owner callback is permanently blocked
factors.workMetric: External blocking time on GC critical path, queue/drain work and unresolved release debt
factors.memoryMetric: Deferred rooted payload, budget reserve and pending descendants
factors.boundary: Queueing a destructor alone removes no cycle; unsupported effects remain explicit and no reclaimed PSTATE may be borrowed
factors.argument_evidenceClass: source-effect inventory and target design; complete deferred-release service not implemented
factors.argument_badHistory: Collector waits for a foreign destructor's owner callback while that owner is parked waiting for collector completion
factors.argument_rule: Release effects and owner affinity are declared; eligible rooted work is accepted before GC resume and drained with descendant accounting after required owners can run
factors.argument_premise: All release producers, native payload dependencies, budgets and failure dispositions covered; ineligible callbacks keep a supported explicit route
factors.argument_refutation: Deferred task still borrows reclaimed PSTATE or requires a callback prohibited by its wait; moving work into a queue alone removes no cycle

factors.scope: direct scope of current alias/control study
factors.mechanism: Independent frame coordinates, untracked aliases and address caches make root repair/restoration disagree; a whole-invocation snapshot would alter lazy tail observations
factors.sourceCondition: One FrameSpec, canonical shared domains, logical revision versus relocation epoch, authentic per-fragment consume and unchanged Scheme winding; all actual writers/consumers migrate
factors.nativeCondition: Multi-shot map, later tail mutation, shared alias writes, GC relocation and concurrent admitted contexts with proper tail space and native-origin behavior
factors.workMetric: Actual reached restore words, certificate validation, barriers, root reload and independent-domain overlap
factors.memoryMetric: Shared captures counted once plus private active frames, live domain/certificate and metadata roots
factors.boundary: CS-BRIDGE/CS-WRITERS remain open; their local premises do not close source frame/wind/native obligations or prove full SMP
factors.argument_evidenceClass: generated frame contracts and native multi-shot witness; universal generated-consumer refinement open
factors.argument_badHistory: Scanner and continuation restore interpret the same frame/link slot under different coordinates or treat raw copy completion as legal resumption
factors.argument_rule: Scheme owns FrameSpec and PointId; generated descriptors serve stack-to-heap mapping, ordinary roots, structural links, tail dispatch and resumption; each multi-shot restore gets a fresh execution view
factors.argument_premise: Every frame kind, dynamic rest/apply, floating materialization, serializer and native return consumer shares the schema; C activation origin remains valid
factors.argument_refutation: One-shot is substituted for multi-shot, or a restored dynamic-wind extent is reused as a current native resource permit

factors.mechanism: Generated headers/objects may have incompatible ancestry; build jobs and processor population are confused with simultaneous same-VM work
factors.sourceCondition: Complete effective options and dynamic inputs bind generated/header/object/link closure; dependency invalidation and action scheduling have explicit ownership
factors.nativeCondition: Exact-profile bootstrap and clean/no-op/leaf/macro controls; separate build concurrency from runtime mutation/GC acceptance
factors.workMetric: Generation/preprocessing/compile/link actions and elapsed work; validation cost versus avoided work
factors.memoryMetric: Build concurrency RSS and artifact retention separately from runtime heap peak
factors.boundary: This is not itself a runtime race cause; cached bootstrap or parallel make is no evidence of SMP scaling
factors.argument_evidenceClass: effective-profile and exact completed-bootstrap reuse observations
factors.argument_badHistory: Compiler or runtime ABI changes but a stale header/archive is reused; make parallelism is mistaken for same-VM SMP population
factors.argument_rule: Typed effective capability and ABI identity bind every generated/native artifact and runtime witness; one shared scheduling budget controls independent actions
factors.argument_premise: Full actual tool/options/input identity and complete product inventory; dynamic build dependencies either controlled or rejected
factors.argument_refutation: A real compiler/header/environment input is absent from the key, or hash validation costs exceed eligible avoided work

factors.mechanism: Scheme semantic decisions are reconstructed in C macros, layouts and consumers; a new wrapper/backend can leave both old owners authoritative
factors.sourceCondition: Scheme completes frame/module/effect/allocation semantics once; modern C consumes one generated ABI; migrate emitters, FFI, root scanners, restorer and module lifetime together
factors.nativeCondition: All admitted frame kinds and target widths, module lifetime and generated/native observations match; no old semantic owner remains authoritative
factors.workMetric: Independent interpretations retired, regenerated closure, descriptor access and semantic lowering work
factors.memoryMetric: Descriptor/module lifetime and generated/native code footprint
factors.boundary: Language/backend adoption supplies no automatic correctness or speed; preserves Gambit multi-shot, tail calls and portable C foundation
factors.argument_evidenceClass: source ownership and target semantic/native contract
factors.argument_badHistory: C macro emission and runtime layout independently reconstruct semantic decisions; unchanged output unnecessarily invalidates downstream native work
factors.argument_rule: Scheme produces completed FrameSpec/ModuleSpec/effect/allocation plans once; modern generated C mechanically realizes them; LLVM/MLIR consumes the same semantics through a separate backend boundary
factors.argument_premise: Generated declarations and runtime/link consumers migrate together; external semantic effects are part of dependency closure
factors.argument_refutation: A second policy remains in C or MLIR, or a Zig/LLVM wrapper is added while all old emitters and interpretation paths remain authoritative

dependencies.why: Worker independence needs a complete frozen root view and park/reload protocol
Unique object authority alone does not prove frame coordinates or structural link completion
Participant withdrawal cannot discard private or descendant work
Final callbacks and resources can outlive execution admission
Frame consumers share a Scheme-owned semantic source
Native results qualify only the actual generated/header/object closure
